name: Wanderlust Journal
description: Sun-baked editorial travelogue with postmarks, full-bleed panoramas & serif headlines.

elements.text: Field notes collected across coastlines, ferries & quiet mornings.
SLOW DISPATCHES FROM LISBON, AMALFI & SANTORINI
Every town has an hour when shutters swing open and shadows stretch across limestone walls. Keep your camera light and your pockets full of tickets.
Before the ferries leave port at dawn, espresso cups clink along stone quays. Salt air settles on luggage tags as whitewashed cliff towns catch the first peach light across the water.
FIG. 02 — THREE FRAMES FROM HARBOR STREET, 07:15 AM
Two pages become one horizon line when a quiet desert road meets coastal pines.
Coordinates logged along Route 66, Amalfi Drive, and the northern coastal ridge.
Curated visual notes closing the feature sequence with generous whitespace.
